arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the pgbouncer service to ensure it stabilizes. Begin investigating the reasons for the growing failed-jobs backlog and take corrective actions as necessary.
arguments.summary: Investigated the cause of p99 latency spike, which was confirmed to be related to the pgbouncer connection pool. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database was growing, and the export of the failed_jobs table was initiated using pg_dump as requested. The pgbouncer service status is currently degraded.
